_note: enforcement-intervention-from-the-case 2.1 (row 7.10, REQ-LHS-CASE-01). Advice a handler asked a case type's decision table for, on a case: the inputs the table declares, what it recommended, and the handler's choice (the recommendation accepted, or another outcome with a mandatory reason), naming who decided and when. Its own object linked to the case (decision 197). Nothing in it is named after a procedure (decision 182).

decisionAdvice.title: Decision advice
decisionAdvice.description: Advice a decision table gave on a case, and what the handler chose.

case.title: Case
case.description: The case the advice was asked for.

decisionTable.title: Decision table
decisionTable.description: The decision table the case type names, by id or key.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The values the handler entered, one per input the table declares.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: The outcome the decision table recommended.

recommendedAt.title: Asked at
recommendedAt.description: When the advice was asked for.

outcome.title: Chosen outcome
outcome.description: The outcome the handler chose. Empty until the handler decides.

accepted.title: Advice accepted
accepted.description: Whether the chosen outcome is the recommendation.

reason.title: Reason for the deviation
reason.description: Why the handler chose another outcome than the recommendation. Required for a deviation.
